cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Credit for the Discovery
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before calling it our discovery, mention who found the receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Yes. After my receipt introduced it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put your name in the report.

mechanism: A directs the report's attribution and rejects mere attendance credit in favor of credit for finding the clue.
confusable: Unlike wanting a name included, A specifies the discovery action that the name must acknowledge.
comparison: Written attribution beside a verb differs from a live introduction at a house tour.
seedUse: The seed's report wording and final correction already enact A's authority over the recognition sought.
